Later source conversion preserved the choice type in source/group/structuredefinition-Group.xml and retained the example.
additional_context: Group is active in source/fhir.ini. Current source lists Reference as an allowed Group.characteristic.value[x] type, group-notes lists Reference among the choice names, and list-Group-examples includes the patient-list example. The originating Zulip patient roster thread supports the same valueReference use case. Later related issues refined adjacent semantics and search behavior: FHIR-17457 clarified members plus characteristics, FHIR-25297 scoped the token characteristic-value search, FHIR-28291 added characteristic-reference search, and FHIR-41583 broadened the Group characteristic model while retaining Reference. Existing combined-branch audits already represent those related issues.
